Access.readOnlyHint: Read-only access: you can view this but not change it.

Forbidden.title: You do not have access
Forbidden.body: Your role cannot open this screen. Ask an administrator if you need it.

ComingSoon.title: {screen} is not available yet
ComingSoon.body: This screen arrives in a later release.

State.notConnected: Not connected to the backend yet. This action becomes available once the API is connected.

Session.unavailableBody: The console could not reach the backend, so your session cannot be loaded. Try again shortly; if it continues, tell your administrator.
Session.noMembershipBody: Your account is not a member of any project. Ask an administrator to add you.

Login.title: Sign in to FFCore
Login.subtitle: Use your work email and password.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.description: A project groups its members, knowledge bases, agents and usage. Create one per team or use case.
Projects.emptyBody: Create the first project, then add members and assign providers to it.
Projects.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; 2-32 characters. It cannot be changed later: it is part of every model name.
Projects.keyInvalid: Use 2-32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.
Projects.name: Name

Members.title: Project members
Members.description: A member's role decides which screens they see; the access mode decides whether they can change things.
Members.emptyBody: Add people to this project and pick their role and access mode.
Members.addNeedsSuperadmin: Adding members needs the user list, which only a superadmin can see. Ask a superadmin to add new members.
Members.noCandidates: Every active user is already a member of this project.

Providers.title: Providers
Providers.description: A provider is a model endpoint such as LLMaaS or a local runtime. Test the connection and assign it to projects.
Providers.emptyBody: Add the first provider, test its connection and assign it to projects.
Providers.label: Name
Providers.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; 2-64 characters. It cannot be changed later.
Providers.keyInvalid: Use 2-64 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.
Providers.driverFixed: The driver cannot be changed; add a new provider instead.
Providers.projectsHint: A provider is always assigned to at least one project.
Providers.secretStored: Stored. Leave empty to keep it.
Providers.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {label}? Its models stop being served.

Models.title: Models
Models.description: Models come from a provider and are grouped by category so agents can pick the right one.
Models.emptyBody: This project has no models yet. Add one from a provider assigned to the project.
Models.name: Name
Models.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Agents that use it stop working.
Models.addNeedsSuperadmin: Adding a model needs a superadmin until providers are listed per project.
Models.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; 2-64 characters. Part of the LiteLLM name; it cannot be changed later.
Models.keyInvalid: Use 2-64 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.
Models.providerFixed: The provider cannot be changed; add a new model instead.
Models.noProviders: No active provider of this project serves this category. A superadmin adds or assigns one on the Providers screen.
Models.modelIdHint: The model's name at the provider, e.g. qwen3.5:35b.
Models.catalogFilled: Filled from the catalog ({source}, as of {asOf}).
Models.catalogMiss: Not in the catalog; enter the values yourself.
Models.catalogNeedsModel: Choose a provider and enter the model ID first.
Models.responsesUnavailable: Not available yet: the gateway refuses models with the Responses API (upstream_api_unsupported).
Models.dropUnsupported: Drop parameters the provider does not support
Models.notInGatewayHint: The gateway does not serve models with the Responses API yet (upstream_api_unsupported).

ProjectSwitcher.label: Project
ProjectSwitcher.selectBody: This screen belongs to a project. Choose one in the project selector at the top.

DevTheme.title: Theme preview
DevTheme.description: Every component in the light and dark theme side by side.
DevTheme.sampleText: Body text on a card surface.

Errors.readOnlyAccess: Read-only access: your access mode does not allow changes here.
Errors.insufficientRole: Your role in this project does not allow this action.
Errors.crossOriginForbidden: The request did not come from the console's own address, so it was refused.
Errors.oboProjectScope: This request is limited to another project.
Errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
Errors.validationError: Some fields are not valid. Check the form and try again.
Errors.projectKeyTaken: This project key is already used. Keys are never reused.
Errors.memberExists: This user is already a member of the project.
Errors.roleReserved: This role cannot be assigned in this release.
Errors.notFound: It no longer exists. Refresh the page.
Errors.providerKeyTaken: This provider key is already used.
Errors.providerInUse: A model still uses this provider. Deactivate or delete those models first.
Errors.providerNotAssigned: The provider is not active in this project. Assign it to the project first.
Errors.providerDomainMismatch: This provider does not serve models of this category.
Errors.modelKeyTaken: This model key is already used in the project.
Errors.embeddingProbeUnavailable: The embedding dimension cannot be measured with this provider yet, so the model cannot be registered.
Errors.embedDimMismatch: The model's embedding dimension does not match the installation's EMBED_DIM.
Errors.domainNotSupported: The driver does not serve one of the selected uses.
Errors.unknownConfigField: The configuration has a field this driver does not know.
Errors.missingConfigField: A required configuration field is empty.
Errors.invalidConfigField: A configuration field is not valid.
Errors.unknownProject: One of the selected projects no longer exists. Refresh the page.
Errors.knowledgeBaseKeyTaken: This knowledge base key is already used in the project.
Errors.aclConflict: Opening documents to every member cannot be combined with roles or users.
Errors.requestTooLarge: The upload is larger than the server accepts. Send fewer or smaller files at once.
Errors.vectorStoreUnavailable: The vector store cannot be reached. See System status.
Errors.networkError: The request did not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.

ProviderTest.title: Connection test
ProviderTest.unsupported: This driver has no connection test.
ProviderTest.connectionFailed: Could not connect to the provider.
ProviderTest.timeout: The provider did not answer in time.
ProviderTest.egressDenied: The outbound policy refused this address. Check OFFLINE, EGRESS_ALLOWLIST and ALLOWED_INTERNAL_HOSTS.
ProviderTest.httpStatus: The provider answered with an error.
ProviderTest.notBlocking: A failed test does not block saving.

base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.hint: Address of the server, e.g. http://ollama:11434.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

api_base.label: Endpoint
api_base.hint: Resource endpoint in the agreed region.

aws_access_key_id.label: Access key ID
aws_access_key_id.hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

aws_secret_access_key.label: Secret access key
aws_secret_access_key.hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

region.label: Region
region.hint: AWS region in the agreed area, e.g. eu-central-1.

KnowledgeBases.title: Knowledge bases
KnowledgeBases.description: Documents the agents search. Upload files, see what each quality gate decided and try a search.
KnowledgeBases.emptyBody: Create a knowledge base first, then upload documents to it.
KnowledgeBases.needsAdmin: Only a project admin can create, change or delete knowledge bases.
KnowledgeBases.name: Name
KnowledgeBases.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter (2-64). It cannot be changed later.
KnowledgeBases.keyInvalid: Use 2-64 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.
KnowledgeBases.chunkSizeHint: Minimum chunk length; the measured default is 400.
KnowledgeBases.chunkOverlapHint: Tokens repeated between chunks; the measured default is 0.
KnowledgeBases.minScoreHint: Used only when the reranker is off. With the reranker on, only the rerank floor applies (one threshold).
KnowledgeBases.deleteConfirm: Delete the knowledge base "{name}"? Its documents leave search at once.

Documents.dropHint: Drag files here or choose them. Each file goes through the quality gates; nothing is dropped silently.
Documents.selected: {count, plural, one {# file selected} other {# files selected}}: {names}
Documents.aclOpenHint: Opens the documents to all members of the project, on purpose. Cannot be combined with roles.
Documents.aclRequired: Choose at least one role or open the documents to every project member.
Documents.emptyBody: Upload documents to build this knowledge base.
Documents.refreshing: Processing; the list refreshes until every document is done.

reasons.videoDisabled: video is not indexed in this installation
reasons.libreofficeUnavailable: this office format needs LibreOffice, which is not installed
reasons.tooLarge: file is larger than the limit
reasons.embeddingTruncated: longer than the embedding model reads

Documents.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? It leaves search at once; the raw file is kept.
Documents.reindexHint: Rebuilds silver (text and gates) or gold (chunks and vectors) from the layer below.
Documents.reindexFull: All documents, not only changed ones

Search.title: Try search
Search.description: Runs the same search agents use, with your access. Logged as a playground query.
Search.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No result} one {# result} other {# results}} in {ms} ms.
Search.thresholdRerank: Threshold: rerank floor. {count, plural, =0 {No chunk was below it.} one {# chunk below it was left out.} other {# chunks below it were left out.}}
Search.thresholdMinScore: Threshold: minimum embedding score. {count, plural, =0 {No chunk was below it.} one {# chunk below it was left out.} other {# chunks below it were left out.}}
Search.noHitsBody: Nothing passed the threshold, or you may not read the documents that match.

SystemStatus.title: System status
SystemStatus.description: Whether the installation can serve: models loaded, configuration consistent, vector store reachable.
SystemStatus.refreshing: Models are loading; this page refreshes every few seconds.
SystemStatus.unreachableTitle: The backend did not answer the readiness check
SystemStatus.unreachableBody: The console could not read /readyz. Details are below.

codes.warmupFailed: Loading the models failed. See the detail and the backend log.
codes.modelMissing: Model weights are not installed. They come only from make models, which the operator runs (it downloads); nothing is downloaded at run time.
codes.contextConfigurationInvalid: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH is not set or is smaller than the largest model context.
codes.embedDimMismatch: The vector column dimension does not match EMBED_DIM.
codes.vectorStoreUnavailable: The vector store cannot be reached.
